Robot Framework has two identities. Everything so far has been **test
automation** — verifying that software behaves. But the same engine also does
**RPA** (robotic process automation) — automating a *process*: fulfilling an
order, onboarding a user, moving files between systems.

The only difference is intent, and one keyword. A `*** Tasks ***` section holds
**tasks** instead of test cases — identical syntax, but they *do* work rather
than *verify* it. Run with `--rpa` (or just use the `*** Tasks ***` header), and
the console and reports say "task" instead of "test".

## Task 1 — Write a task

**Goal:** create `checks/fulfil.robot` with a `*** Tasks ***` section defining a
task that automates the steps of fulfilling an order.

Here is the same shape for a different process. Adapt it to order fulfilment.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Tasks ***
Onboard A User
    Log    Creating account
    Log    Sending welcome email
    Log    Adding to directory
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `checks/fulfil.robot` defines the task `Fulfil The Order`.

<!-- hint -->
Use a `*** Tasks ***` section header (not `*** Test Cases ***`) — everything else
is the same syntax.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Give the task a few steps, e.g. `Log    Picking items`, `Log    Printing label`,
`Log    Marking shipped`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Tasks ***
Fulfil The Order
    Log    Picking items
    Log    Printing label
    Log    Marking shipped
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it in RPA mode

Run it as a task:

```bash
uv run robot --rpa checks/fulfil.robot
```

Notice the wording — the tally counts a **task**, not a test:

```terminal
$ uv run robot --rpa checks/fulfil.robot
==============================================================================
Fulfil
==============================================================================
Fulfil The Order                                                      | PASS |
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1 task, 1 passed, 0 failed
==============================================================================
```

Same engine, RPA intent.

**Check:** the task `Fulfil The Order` runs and passes.
